decisions.briefing: Markets were flat to slightly down today (NASDAQ -0.2%, S&P 500 -0.1%) with no strong risk-on or risk-off signal. Since cash was above the $500 threshold with 3 open slots, we deployed modest medium-conviction capital into three diversified, high-scoring momentum names (PARR, CDNA, CHTR) rather than holding idle cash, per the risk rules' preference for filling open slots.

market_education.summary_en: Today's trading was largely directionless, with both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 posting only marginal declines of around 0.1-0.2%. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the session, suggesting markets are consolidating recent gains while investors await further data. This kind of low-volatility, range-bound action is typical between major earnings or macroeconomic releases.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢較為反覆,納指及標普500指數分別微跌0.2%及0.1%,未見明顯主導消息帶動。市場似乎處於鞏固早前升幅的階段,投資者正等待更多經濟數據及企業業績公佈。這種低波動、區間徘徊的格局,在重磅消息公佈前的平靜期頗為常見。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, based on signals like rising price above moving averages and bullish technical indicators (RSI, MACD). The idea is that stocks showing strong recent performance tend to keep performing well in the near term, though this can reverse quickly if momentum fades.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動量投資策略是指買入已經呈現上升趨勢的股票,依據的訊號包括股價高於移動平均線,以及RSI、MACD等技術指標呈現利好。這種策略的邏輯是近期表現強勁的股票,短期內有機會延續升勢,但一旦動力減退,走勢亦可能迅速逆轉。
